author: feenberg
body:
I think part of the problem with the TA calculation is with the age of the taxpayers, but that isn't everything. I am giving up on TA for this taxpayer and will just try to get taxsim to match PE.  Some questions:

1) Does PE care that the oldest taxpayer is only 47? Does PE want to give all the pension to that taxpayer because they are the eoldest? I was splitting the pension unless the oldest was >=65 and the other was <65. I can always give pension income to the oldest  if you think that is better.

2) Does PE think pension income is always "normal distribution" and therefore eligible for exclusion? I have been looking at each state for an age limit. It seems that many have a limit, but with exceptions. We could document that pension income is assumed to be eligible for special treatment, regardless of age.
